title: Cogs of Symmetry
speaker: kenji
intro: A gear must be symmetrical, Max-kun — fold it in half in your mind. If both halves match, it spins true; if not, it wobbles the whole machine!
success: Perfectly sorted! Only true-spinning cogs for our gear train.

items.label: Six-tooth cog
items.fact: Fold it through the middle — every tooth lines up with a partner.

items.label: Star plate
items.fact: A star has lots of fold lines — symmetry everywhere!

items.label: Heart cam
items.fact: A heart shape has one line of symmetry, right down the middle.

items.label: Bent rod
items.fact: Bent on one side only — no fold makes the halves match.

items.label: Chipped cog
items.fact: One missing tooth ruins the mirror — and the spin.

items.label: Squiggle bracket
items.fact: A squiggle leans one way — its halves never mirror.
